body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
Just a friendly reminder that your invoice from @Order.OrderDate@ is available for payment.
You can securely view, download, and pay your invoice online through the Customer Portal.
Log in here:
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
If it’s your first time logging in, please use this temporary password:
@Customer.CustomerID@
Once logged in:
Select My Account
Choose Pay beside your invoice
Complete your payment
If you'd rather make a payment over the phone, give us a call.
Call us anytime Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214.
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
